result.sector: Power transmission EPC (T&D towers, lines, substations)
result.hard_numeric_fact_text: GETCO LoA Rs689.93cr (765kV DC Pachchham-Saykha, 42 months, turnkey) filed 2026-10-23; about 54% of annual revenue per the dossier, but only ~Rs197cr/yr of revenue over 42 months (CALCULATION). Q1 FY27 total income Rs255.18cr (+57.1% YoY), EBITDA Rs24.97cr (+90.0%), net profit Rs19.46cr (+74.4%) (FACT, standalone press release).

risk.governance: MEDIUM: CFO role relinquished 2026-10-15 (replaced by a 36-year insider, outgoing CFO stays as WTD to 2028); internal auditor Bhushan Khot removed 2026-08-04; NSE sought clarification on Q1 results 2026-08-28; history of restructuring
risk.balance_sheet: HIGH: net debt/EBITDA 28.4, EBITDA/invested capital 2.7% (dossier, CALCULATION)
risk.cycle: MEDIUM: T&D capex cycle strong but EPC margins are thin and order-driven
risk.dilution: HIGH: board is evaluating raising up to Rs250cr (about 26% of the Rs974cr market cap) and authorised capital was raised to 160cr shares
risk.order_firmness: MEDIUM: single LoA from a state utility, not yet a contract; 42-month execution

result.thesis: Q1 FY27 shows real operating leverage (income +57%, EBITDA +90%) and a Rs690cr GETCO LoA adds a transmission order. But the cash flow does not support it: CFO/PAT is -4.8, net debt/EBITDA is 28x and the receivables base is a legacy problem. PAT is helped by a ~1% tax rate, the dossier flags 17.5% of EBITDA as one-off, a Rs250cr fund raise is under consideration, and the CFO seat and internal-audit arrangements changed within 11 weeks. The order is large against the market cap but spreads over 42 months. Not a clean inflection yet.
chain_missing_links: balance-sheet capacity to fund working capital without dilution
result.demand_signal: Gujarat 765kV transmission award plus Sri Lanka 220kV contract; sector tender flow strong (MANAGEMENT CLAIM, press release 2026-10-23)
result.supply_signal: unknown; EPC execution capacity not disclosed
result.pricing_signal: unknown; EBITDA margin 9.8% on company definition (FACT) vs 8.4% in dossier
result.order_book: Total order book unknown (not in filings pack). Disclosed LoAs: Rs689.93cr (2026-10-23), Rs67.96cr (2026-05-13). GETCO order is a Letter of Award, so I haircut it 50% until a contract and revenue appear (rule).
result.capacity_catalyst: none disclosed; Ahmedabad project office opened (MANAGEMENT CLAIM)
result.valuation: Mcap Rs974cr; TTM P/E 15.1; EV/EBITDA 42.3 (CALCULATION). EV/EBITDA at 42x against 15x P/E shows the P/E relies on low tax and the thin EBITDA base.

plausible.2x: NO: needs FY28 EPS ~1.5 at P/E 11, i.e. a roughly 2.5x jump in earnings with no dilution; an announced fund raise works against it

kill_conditions: Equity raise at a deep discount or large promoter-linked preferential issue
Q2 FY27 CFO/PAT still negative or receivables rising faster than revenue
Q2 revenue growth below 25% YoY or EBITDA margin below 8%
Auditor qualification or further KMP exits
catalysts: GETCO contract signing and mobilisation advance
result.biggest_risk: Working-capital-heavy EPC with 28x net debt/EBITDA; growth consumes cash and the Rs250cr raise dilutes holders.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: CFO/PAT, receivables, tax rate and the size and price of the Rs250cr fund raise.
result.material_change: First review. New fact since the dossier base: GETCO Rs689.93cr LoA (2026-10-23). CFO change (2026-10-15) is a governance flag. Dossier conflict: the dossier shows EBITDA +208% YoY and margin 8.4%, while the company press release says EBITDA +90% and margin 9.79% (differing definitions/other income). I use the company filing for growth and the dossier for forensics.
